## Not adopted

### `browser-testing-with-devtools` — rejected

*agent-skills · `7676817` · ruled in round-002-drop-ui-scope*

OUT OF SCOPE — its declared trigger is 'building or debugging anything that runs in a browser', and its whole method is DOM inspection, console capture, network inspection and visual verification. With UI work out of scope it has nothing to fire on. It also carried the roster's only external MCP dependency (the chrome-devtools server), so removing it drops a setup requirement as well. This is a judgement call rather than a certainty: a backend developer debugging a web service could in principle use it, which is why it is recorded explicitly rather than swept in silently. Reinstate from round-001 if browser-facing work appears.

**Deliberately dropped:**

- live browser runtime inspection, console error capture, network request analysis, and the browser-profile blast-radius analysis
